definition: AlphaDev is an artificial intelligence system developed by Google DeepMind to discover enhanced computer science algorithms using reinforcement learning.
details: AlphaDev is based on AlphaZero, a system that mastered the games of chess, shogi and go by self-play. AlphaDev applies the same approach to finding faster algorithms for fundamental tasks such as sorting and hashing.
story: Picture training a puppy: no long lectures, just treats for the right move and patience for the wrong one. It learns the way a child learns to walk: wobble, fall, adjust, repeat. Instead of being told the rules, it discovers them by living with the consequences. It is trial and error with a memory: actions that pay off get repeated, actions that hurt get dropped. That learn-by-reward loop is AlphaDev.
